title: Ukrainian Skillet Panak
description: A hearty Ukrainian skillet dish made with vegan sausages and Comte cheese. Serve with a side of rye bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegan sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegan broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the Comte cheese until melted.
Season with paprika, salt, and black pepper to taste.
